text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One morning, while walking to the
academy...

Ding, dong, ding! Ding, dong, d-d-drop
the beat!
Wahey! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Helios here with the latest weather
forecast! And
guess what!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Today, we'll be seeing a downpour of...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eeeeek!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Scatter!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Caaandy! Wahey, take as much as you
want! ☆

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's raining so much candy! Ahaha!
Running
wild again today, huh, Helios?

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, not again... Some of us are trying
to focus
here—hm?

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
There's a note stuck to the wrapper.
"The worse
your test grade, the more
likes it gets on
Umasta"? Pfft, what the
heck?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I thought sharing some of my original
quotes
would, like, motivate everyone.
So I went ahead
and stuck 'em on the
candy!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Helios's Hype Heaven Week starts now!
Stay
tuned, 'cause I'm your girl Helios,
and I'm gonna
give this place a divine
makeover!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Daitaku Helios starts livening up
the
academy with her antics every day.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Prank patrol, roll out!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna make you more colorful than a
rainbow!
Graaah! ☆

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Eeek! What are you sprinkling on my
foo—is that
gold leaf?! My fried rice is
luckier than lucky now!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, how'd you turn my regular ice
cream into a
supersized Pegasus parfait?!
You're so goated for
this, Helios!

text_block_list.name: Helios and Windy
text_block_list.text:
There's more pranks where that came
from! ☆

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
My food's changed too! My kid's meal
turned into
real fancy cuisine with
sparkly cream!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you should get them to make your
chicken
fingers and broccoli sparkly too!
It'll be way more
fun eating them that
way!

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text: Uh, yeah... I'll think about it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One week of wild antics later...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And that's a wrap for Helios's Hype
Heaven
Week! Thanks for joining the
party, y'all!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Aw, it's over already? This was like, the
craziest
week ever!  Actually, I can't
believe the teachers
didn't get on your
case!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's 'cause my bestie hashed it
out with
them for me!

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
Um, Helios... I just wanted to say you
made
coming to school really fun. So,
thanks!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you don't have to thank me! For
real, for
real!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I'm just not a fan of being bored, so I wanted to liven things up! So thank you for putting up with me! ☆

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, well then, you're welcome. Just
kidding!
Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the way she pulled everyone into
the fun and
made them smile was so
precious... Helios... My
angel...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey there, Rubae! What did you
think about
my Hype Heaven Week?
Did it get you more
excited to come to
school?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
No, not particularly. Now then, if you'll
excuse
me.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Forget cold shoulder—she just froze me
out
completely! I think I'm low-key never
gonna get
to see Rubae smile my whole
life!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
...Well, how about you? Did you dig my
Hype
Heaven?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
What, not enough for you?! Here's a
double
serving of something special! ☆
First up, some
sick beats! Let's gooo! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
...Well, whatever! We need to get the
wrap-up
party started!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Dotsy, Win-dings, Digiridoo, and
Palmster in the
hooouse! ☆ Time to
par-tay!
